description: This file defines an abstract class MemoryConsumer in the org.apache.spark.memory package, representing a memory consumer that supports spilling for Tungsten memory in Spark. It includes methods for memory allocation, spilling, and management, and references external classes such as TaskMemoryManager, MemoryMode, LongArray, and MemoryBlock.

classes.name: MemoryConsumer
classes.description: An abstract class representing a memory consumer in Spark that supports spilling, managing Tungsten memory, with methods for allocation, spilling, and memory tracking.

methods.name: getMode
methods.description: Returns the memory mode, either ON_HEAP or OFF_HEAP.

methods.name: getUsed
methods.description: Returns the amount of memory currently used in bytes.

methods.name: spill
methods.description: Forces spilling of memory to disk; to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: allocateArray
methods.description: Allocates a LongArray of specified size, may throw out-of-memory errors.

methods.name: allocatePage
methods.description: Allocates a memory page with at least the required size.

methods.name: acquireMemory
methods.description: Allocates memory of specified size, returning the granted amount.

methods.name: freeMemory
methods.description: Releases a specified amount of memory.
